Every phone number and tariff here came off the cited page on the date shown and has NOT been dialled — verify before going live, and get the owner's consent before publishing a personal mobile number.
$meta.privacy: Phone numbers and emails below are already published on government or business listing pages. Even so, get written consent from each host before republishing a personal mobile on the platform.

homestays.title: Keibul Homestay – Loktak Lake
homestays.location: On Loktak Lake, reached by boat from Moirang Bazar
amenities: free boat pickup from Moirang Bazar
homestays.how_to_reach: Boat pickup from Moirang Bazar — 2 km, 15–20 minutes. Bir Tikendrajit International Airport 44 km. Nearest railhead Dimapur, 253 km.
homestays.notes: May be the same operation as Loktak Aquamarine Homestay below — same host surname, same area. Confirm before creating two listings.

homestays.title: Maipakchao Family Home Stay
homestays.location: Thanga Khoirom Leikai, Thanga island, Loktak Lake
activities: hand-rowed wooden boat rides across the lake
sunrise climb on the Thanga hill
homestays.notes: Ranked #1 B&B/inn in Thanga Khoirom Leikai on TripAdvisor. Listed on Responsible Tourism India as a community-income alternative to fishing on a stressed lake — good fit for the sustainable-tourism theme. No phone published; contact is via Facebook.

homestays.title: Loktak Aquamarine Homestay
homestays.notes: Registered with Manipur Tourism — the strongest verification of any homestay in this set. Tariff and room count not published; call to obtain.

homestays.title: Manipur Royal Holidays Homestay
homestays.location: Awang Sekmai New Market, Imphal West 795136
homestays.notes: Registered with Manipur Tourism. Room count inferred from the photographs on the official page — confirm.

homestays.title: Budha Loktak Homestays
homestays.notes: Facebook page only. Verify it is still trading before listing.

homestays.title: The Giving Tree by Eventus
homestays.location: Three properties in and around Imphal, including 'Hearth of Imphal'
amenities: lawn with food garden and pond
homestays.notes: The only homestay named on the Imphal West district accommodation page. Describes itself as an ecologically conscious retreat with three properties — a strong fit for the eco-tourism theme. Room detail is for the 'Hearth of Imphal' property from its Airbnb listing.

homestays.title: Bougain Villa Imphal
homestays.notes: Boutique homestay; its rooms are themed on Manipuri motifs (e.g. a Shirui Lily room). Airbnb-only listing — confirm directly before publishing.

homestays.title: Ancestral Homestay
homestays.notes: An ancestral house rebuilt in 1947 after being bombed in WWII and restored again in 2007 — a genuine Battle of Imphal story if the owner will tell it. Airbnb-only; confirm directly.

hotels_and_resorts.$note: From the official Manipur Tourism accommodation directory unless stated. 'category' and 'rooms' are as published by the department. Addresses are mostly not published there — collect them before listing.

items.notes: Marketed as Sangai Continental (The Boutique Hotel); 3-star on OTAs, with business centre and airport transfers.

items.name: Hotel Yaiphaba
items.notes: MG Avenue Road, near City Police, Thangal Bazar. Alternate mobile listed on aggregator: +91 98560 10386.

items.name: Hotel Bheigo
items.notes: Known locally for Manipuri cuisine in its restaurant.

items.name: Sendra Resort
items.notes: Sendra Park and Resort, on the Sendra hillock over Loktak, about 3 km from Moirang. Run by The Classic group. Cottages with cane furniture and water-reed cushions; limited rooms, book well ahead. Manipur Tourism also refers to a Sendra Tourist Home with cafeteria at the same hillock.
